falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 closes above its 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear bullish breakout would invalidate the HOLD signal and suggest a trend reversal contrary to the bottom pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 60 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant rise in blowoff score would indicate a confirmed blowoff top scenario, directly contradicting the bottom pattern analysis

falsification_conditions.condition: The U.S. Non-Farm Payrolls report shows employment growth of 250,000 or more in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a strong economic indicator would create upward momentum invalidating the market's current HOLD position

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
